crude-birth-rate.def: The number of births in a year for every 1,000 people in a population.

crude-death-rate.def: The number of deaths in a year for every 1,000 people in a population.

total-fertility-rate.def: The average number of children a woman would have in her lifetime if the birth rates of one year stayed the same.

infant-mortality-rate.def: The number of babies who die before their first birthday for every 1,000 live births.

life-expectancy.def: The average number of years a newborn can expect to live if the death rates of its birth year stay the same.

rate-of-natural-increase.def: The crude birth rate minus the crude death rate, given as a percent (divide by 10). It leaves out migration.

doubling-time.def: The number of years a population takes to double at a steady growth rate. By the rule of 70, it is about 70 divided by the growth rate in percent.

replacement-fertility.def: The total fertility rate at which each generation just replaces itself: about 2.1 births per woman where few children die.
